    y(t)=-h'(t)-Re g(t),      z(t)=-Im g(t).

Radiation norm conservation gives the compatibility identity

    r^T r' = h^T y.                                     (B)

For `||h||>0`, put

    C = r' h^T/||h||^2 + r y^T/||r||^2
        - (r^T r') r h^T/(||r||^2 ||h||^2),

    Q = (z h^T+h z^T)/||h||^2
        - (h^T z) h h^T/||h||^4.

These **real** matrices satisfy

    C h=r',     C^T r=y,       Q h=z.
